notes:
2026-09-11, later: added a real self-tap COST fact, {event:'tap', subject:'self', target:'self'} — the {T} activation-cost payment itself, kept as its own fact distinct from the tap-TARGET effect fact (which taps some OTHER creature). No trace evidence can ever exist for it (engine.ts's activateAbility pays {T} via a bare engine.state.tap call, no log line) — confirmed a real false-pass risk in verify-synergy.mjs's forward check (bare event-name equality would have silently, wrongly credited this fact using the UNRELATED tap-target effect's own real fn:'tap' evidence) and added a general (not per-card) isSelfTapActivationCostFact exemption scoped to the exact subject:'self'/target:'self' shape. Also added the same fact to dion-bahamut-s-dominant-bahamut-warden-of-light (front face, {4}{W}{W}, {T}: Exile...) — the only other fin/1-20 card with a real {T} in its own activationCost (checked all 20 fresh against real oracle text). find-synergies.mjs before/after (isolated swap): 0 diff both cards — real, documented zero-match gap, no pool card wants event:'tap' targeting self yet. verify-synergy.mjs (scoped + full pool 314) 0 hard failures; vitest 238/238.

Earlier, 2026-09-11: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/12, continuation of the fin/1-10 rollout). Replaced the old sink-only, sourceText/highlight/id-shaped synergy.json with: `self-cast` ({event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored, 'Creature'), `self-enters` ({event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', subject:'self', target:'self'}, same anchor), and a real SOURCE fact for the ability itself ({event:'tap', target:{types:{has:['Creature'],not:['Enchantment']}}, targeted:true}, oracle-anchored 'Tap target nonenchantment creature'). Kept a companion SINK ({to:'Battlefield', types:{has:['Creature'],not:['Enchantment']}}, oracle-anchored 'target nonenchantment creature') mirroring Battle Menu's own precedent of pairing a targeted ability's constraint with a 'wants that type present' want, rather than relying on the SOURCE target constraint alone — real, established pool pattern, not invented for this card. Added real `pt:[2,2]` to definition.ts (was silently defaulting to a fake 1/1). Card added to `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS`; annotations baked via compute-annotations.mjs.

`event:'tap'` promoted off `verify-synergy.mjs`'s `PARKED_ACTION_FNS` to real vocabulary (first card in the migrated pool whose own EFFECT, not just its {T} activation cost, is a tap — the cost payment itself is confirmed silent, `engine.ts`'s `activateAbility` calls bare `engine.state.tap` with no log line, so the real `fn:'tap'` trace line is genuinely the targeted-tap effect). Added `producedEvents`'s `case 'tap'` and `tap` to `explainableFns`. Known, expected, documented side effect (same class as the `pump` promotion): removing `tap` from `PARKED_ACTION_FNS` surfaces real `fn:'tap'` trace lines as SOFT notes (never hard failures) on ~20 other, still-unmigrated (v1-schema) pool cards with real tapTarget effects (tonberry, ice-flan, sleep-magic, elixir, and others) — previously silently parked, now visible, correctly non-fatal.

New harness gap surfaced and fixed: Coeurl is the first migrated card whose PERMANENT carries a top-level `activationCost` — `lifecycleBefore` (harness.ts) always takes the `card.activationCost` branch for such a card, so NO scenario can ever produce a real `fn:'cast'`/`fn:'enters'` trace line, structurally (checked fin/1-11: none have a top-level activationCost, so this never surfaced before). Added a new, general `isActivationCostPermanentBaselineFact` exemption to `verify-synergy.mjs` (same 'known statically, no trace needed' treatment as `isStaticOnlyLand`), scoped to `subject:'self'`/`target:'self'` baseline facts on any activationCost-bearing permanent — not hardcoded to this one card, since any future migrated card with the same shape will hit the identical structural gap.

Real `find-synergies.mjs` diff (isolated via a same-pool-state before/after swap, re-run after an unrelated concurrent pool-wide `value` sentinel convention change landed mid-task): incoming edges (Coeurl as sink) unchanged, 97 -> 97, byte-identical set — the new `not:['Enchantment']` constraint excluded zero real matches (none of the 97 real producers are Enchantment Creatures). Outgoing edges (Coeurl as source) 0 -> 127: 126 real 'enters the battlefield' matches gained via the new `self-enters` baseline fact (Coeurl now satisfies every unconstrained battlefield-presence want in the pool, since it's an ordinary, unfiltered Creature) plus 1 self-interaction (second-copy, a real second Coeurl entering while one is already out). `self-cast`/`event:'tap'` matched zero sinks (no pool card wants `event:'cast'`/`event:'tap'` yet) — expected, same 'promotes vocabulary, creates no match today' pattern as `pump`'s own promotion. `verify-synergy.mjs` (scoped + full pool): 0 hard failures either way (2 pre-existing hard failures elsewhere in the pool, fate-of-the-sun-cryst/from-father-to-son, both unrelated concurrent in-flight work, not touched). `vitest run functional-model`: 238/238.
